submitted.rationale: EQE rises steadily as Sb content increases: 0.0003% at 61% Sb, 0.0045% at 79% Sb and 0.0055% at 81% Sb (index 29, the most Sb-rich point in the library). XRD shows the same Sb-oxide-type phase at 73% and 81% Sb. Index 29 also has extra weak peaks, which fits more of the visible-absorbing, mixed-valence Sb oxide. MgO and MgSb2O6 have wide band gaps and should not absorb 2.7 eV light.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.0003%, about 20x lower; the MgSb2O6-rich region has a wide band gap
Mostly MgO or Mg-Sb oxides with wide band gaps, so little absorption at 2.7 eV; EQE falls as Sb decreases
